integrity: The analytical proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic checker are supplied. The moment identity and the global positive-part lemma yield the universal conclusion; finite checks supplement rather than replace these proofs.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficient quadratic Walsh chaos, independent fair signs, and finite two-layer prisms over triangle- and square-free graphs of maximum degree two. The upper endpoint and rigidity do not assert a corresponding theorem for arbitrary base graphs or other moments.
title: Sharp fourth-moment face localization on two-layer graphs with overlapping squares
